name: pocket-watch
description: Chronomètre Souverain (Calibre FS-1903 Tourbillon) — FrankenSim interactive multiphysics horology, phase-change melting, cryogenic quenching, tribology, magnetostatics, and 3D virtual microphone lab.

scripts.build:cf: tsc --noEmit && vite build --base /chronometer/ --outDir dist-cf/chronometer --emptyOutDir && cp cloudflare/_headers dist-cf/_headers && cp cloudflare/.assetsignore dist-cf/.assetsignore
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:cf && npx wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.wasm: RUSTFLAGS="--force-warn=dead_code" CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rch_target_frankensim_watch /Users/jemanuel/.cargo/bin/cargo lbuild --offline --manifest-path engine-watch/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm-pkg ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rch_target_frankensim_watch/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fs_pocket_watch.wasm
